title: A test of Back must assert the URL it comes back to
rule: When a test goes Back from a pushed page, capture page.url() before the push and assert toHaveURL(url) after Back. A visible list or a kept filter also holds when the code replaced the entry with a fresh route, so it cannot tell a pop from a replace. Do this after the steps that could add history too, such as next and previous arrows.
rationale: E42.1 (#452): with the family arrows changed to router.push, Esc replaced to #/ and lost the ?face= query, and the arrows test still passed because it checked only the tree and the search box.
